verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

verses.pali: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni.
verses.english: These are the five powers of a lady.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṁ ajjhāvasatī”ti.
verses.english: A lady living at home with these five qualities is self-assured.”
